text:
sara_peopleops: Quick run-through before I publish the Q3 review timeline tomorrow. Two clarifications: 1) extension policy for emergency launches vs. routine delays, 2) whether proxies can submit manager comments on behalf of traveling managers. Please reply with a short line. :eyes:

linda_hr: Extensions: emergency launches get a 72h exception with manager note; routine delays get a 48h grace at HR discretion. All exceptions must be logged in the audit column. Proxies can submit manager comments only if approved in the "Proxy" column and DM'd to HR ahead of time.

eng-manager-raj: For proxy flow: can the proxy upload a DRAFT and then the manager finalizes when back? Our leads often prefer to tweak wording.

calib-lead-ana: Yes — proxies can upload drafts marked DRAFT. Final must be uploaded by the exception deadline; otherwise the draft will be treated as the manager comment. Leads will check for "DRAFT" prefix.

contractor-lucas: Small vendor note: contractors sometimes need extra time to pull metrics from external dashboards. Can we add a contractor checkbox in the form so exceptions are auto-tagged?

linda_hr: Good idea. We'll add a "contractor/new-hire" checkbox and an "exception reason" free-text field in the form. That will appear in the audit log but not in the redacted pre-read.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Managers on the early-review list have manager comment drafts due in 48 hours. Check your calendar.

sara_peopleops: Draft checklist I'll publish tonight (short):
- IC self-assessments due: 2026-09-10 23:59 PT
- Exception window (emergency launches): +72h if manager annotated; routine delays: +48h at HR discretion
- Manager comments due: 2026-09-12 17:00 PT (24h buffer after IC deadline)
- Final uploads to /Shared/Reviews/2026-Q3 by: 2026-09-13 12:00 PT
- Calibration votes (sheet) close: 2026-09-14 10:00 PT
- Proxy approvals must be DM'd to HR and recorded in the sheet by: 2026-09-11 17:00 PT

linda_hr: One-line blurb managers can forward: "Please include top 3 outcomes (metrics when possible), 1 cross-team impact example, 1 development goal, and 1 artifact link. Contractors/new hires: note ramp or external dashboard limitations. Keep ~150-300 words."

eng-manager-raj: Thanks — will forward. One ask: can appeals be submitted within 48h after final calibration notes published? We need a predictable window for our teams.

linda_hr: Yes, 48h appeals window post-publication. Appeals should be a single-paragraph manager submission with supporting artifacts; HR triages and records outcome.

sara_peopleops: Final ask: leads, please confirm you can accept proxy DRAFTs and that you'll flag any unfinalized drafts during the meeting. If no issues I'll post the timeline to #announcements tomorrow AM. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
